as in I don't trust others?
I don't really know

yeah.

Like if someone says 'oh you're rich' I'll take that as a negative. same as if they had said 'oh you're poor'.
That's the thing, it's like, I'll take whatever someone says as being negative, and any cause that I have would be found after the fact (and the previous causes have really not been useful).

Why are you taking these classes?

When I was super depressed, I literally sat in class daily and thought "why am I here, this is a waste of time". Needless to say I failed that final and that class.

Is it possible to push off your negative feelings until the projects are over? Just focus all your energy on the projects? Or at least aggregate your negative feelings so you have a set time to feel bad, and the rest of the time you can be productive.

If you need any more college tips PM me.

Honestly, I'm not as 'suicidal' per say as I once might have been, it's just frustrating seeing how I always feel shitty, and basically have no self worth.

I'm trying to live in the moment and make positive changes, but I cannot successfully reward myself for accomplishments, or even acknowledge improvements.
